For Sites source helper, first run open mode and retain its returned opening result; then run publish mode with that exact result. If sandbox DNS blocks the official host, retry the same helper with approved network access; do not change origin or use a guessed endpoint.
Preserve the old dirty NeTelegram checkout; build and commit only from the canonical checkout from the project context index unless a separate reconciliation is planned.
Do not rerun full suites or rebuild unchanged app source. Tie each validation to the changed app-source SHA and keep accountless CI evidence separate from real Telegram coverage.

Before build, launch, or publish: verify canonical path, remote, branch, full repo HEAD, upstream, dirty state, and app-source SHA. If checkpoint and Git disagree, reconcile state first; do not build. Keep app-source, docs HEAD, Site-source/version/deployment, and any built-bundle SHA as separate fields.

On resume read PROJECT-STATE, the newest RUN-LOG entry, and only relevant ACCEPTANCE cases. Reuse PASS only for matching source/input, harness, and environment; after two identical failures diagnose before retrying. On verifier anomalies inspect the raw artifact/HTTP response first.

Run Sites helper only from the dedicated Site checkout returned by its opening result, never from the app repository; on DNS denial, keep the same helper/remote and retry with authorized network access.

The APP04 CI smoke initially counted the status-bar service window as a user window and recorded launch before AppKit presentation. The final verified metric counts only visible titled app windows and records launch after visibility; keep those semantics in the CI artifact and devlog. Do not treat failed diagnostic runs as passes.

For a site-wide layout change, use one shared build-time shell and route content source, then validate all route structure/links and visually inspect the homepage plus one dense route before publishing. If public rendering exposes a layout defect, correct the existing source and publish a new immutable Site version; final evidence must name the exact current version.

Current-run source of truth is git HEAD/origin/main; do not launch historical Dev.app artifacts. CI tests run only for app/test/workflow inputs; JSON checks use metadata-only workflow. Reuse evidence only for matching SHA and harness.

The pinned TDLib/Dev.app workflow no longer runs automatically for source-only Swift changes; core Swift CI covers those changes. Use workflow_dispatch for a native bundle check when TDLib/runtime integration or a frozen release candidate needs it.
